text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I walked down the hallway, I heard
dissatisfied voices from some Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, homework is the wooorst!
Training's cancelled today, so I thought
I'd finally get to go out and play!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ugh~, there's so much of it and it looks super hard...
This is gonna take the whole daaay~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there!
You're wasting your time moping around like that!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Because I just don't like studying...
Heart, isn't homework a total drag for you too?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Why? Isn't that wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, whyyy...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's all a matter of perspective.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think you guys are treating this task
like a chore you're being forced to do?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm thinking about how to make it exciting.
—After all, 'I' am the one doing it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Actually, I heard there's a café that supports students and serves delicious pancakes too! I was thinking of doing my homework there.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That sounds amazing! Can I come too?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Me too, me too~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Just follow my lead♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Why not turn the tables and enjoy the challenges instead!
I'll take on as many as you can throw at me!
choice_data_list: You've got really strong resolve, don't you?
I can see why everyone looks up to them.
I can see why everyone looks up to them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Why not turn the tables and enjoy the challenges instead!
I'll take on as many as you can throw at me!
choice_data_list: You've got really strong resolve, don't you?
I can see why everyone looks up to them.
I can see why everyone looks up to them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wouldn't you rather have fun if you can?
Especially when facing tough situations.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Always keep a strong heart――
That's what makes Daring Heart strong... or so they say♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It wasn't something I planned, but I'm glad everyone's getting into it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heart's got a big heart, after all!
Fufu, just kidding♪
